messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — we saw a recurring pattern where token rotations + deploy ordering caused short windows of stale claims and a parallel gap in audit events. I want explicit owners, short timelines, and a recurring check so this doesn't slip.
lee: Can you summarise the recurring pattern you saw? Was it always during deploys?
maria: Mostly during rolling deploys that touched validators and the auth cache service. Typical sequence: new validator deployed -> old tokens still in cache -> requests served with stale claims until a 401 or cache TTL. Audit shipper had transient lag during the spike, dropping ~30s of events.
harry: I can take ownership of the cache TTL/invalidations. Plan: add event-driven invalidation when a role-change webhook is published, plus an immediate-on-401 revalidation fallback. Small PR + feature flag. ETA: short sprint, complete by Thu COB.
lee: I'll own the integration tests and a small fix to the validator client so it returns a strict 401 and diagnostic header when claims mismatch. Test will simulate deploy order and token swap. ETA: Mon.
ops-sre: I'll dig into the audit-shipper gap. Early look shows Kafka consumer rebalance + GC pauses. I'll add a bounded local buffer + retry + metric to surface dropped events. ETA: tomorrow morning. Also suggest a temporary throttling rule on deploys to reduce concurrency to consumers.
maria: Good. Two operational asks: 1) add a recurring weekly audit for consumer lag spikes for the next 4 weeks, 2) add a single-line runbook step for oncall: "if you see 401 spike, trigger force-token-refresh on the service and escalate to ops-sre".
oncall-bot: Created reminder: weekly-consumer-lag-check at 09:00 every Monday for 4 weeks. Added watchers: maria, lee, harry, ops-sre.
harry: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/runtime/pulls/1450 - feature-flag `auth.cache_invalidate_on_event`. Includes unit + e2e harness. Requesting review from @lee and @ops-sre.
lee: Test harness PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/runtime/pulls/1451 - includes a deploy-order simulator and asserts revalidation on 401 returns fresh claims.
ops-sre: Audit shipper mitigation PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/pulls/820 - local buffer + idempotent retry. Also added consumer-lag alert: kafka.consumer.lag > 5000 -> page ops-sre.
maria: I'm creating a short remediation ticket SEC-2992 with a 1-week sprint board and daily 10m standups. Owners: harry (cache work), lee (tests), ops-sre (audit shipper), maria (runbook + coordination). Please add time estimates in the ticket.
lee: Putting estimates in SEC-2992 now.
harry: If anyone hits blocker (permissions for the webhook), ping me and I'll unblock access.
ops-sre: I'll start the throttling rule as a safe guard and observe over the next 48h.
maria: Thanks all. We'll meet for a 15m handoff tomorrow 10:00 PST to walk the rollout and rollback criteria. Bring PR links and smoke test steps. :thumbsup:
lee: ack
harry: ack
ops-sre: ack
oncall-bot: SEC-2992 created and linked to SRV-4330. Status: open.
